scenario: A coach bus overtakes the ego vehicle with minimal side clearance on a multi-lane highway at night before merging back ahead.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward in its lane on the highway.

adversarials.behavior: The coach bus overtakes the ego vehicle in the adjacent lane with minimal side clearance, then merges back into the ego lane ahead of the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: On a multi-lane highway at night, the ego vehicle travels in one lane while the coach bus approaches from behind in an adjacent lane to the right, overtakes with close lateral proximity, and then moves ahead into the ego's lane.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned overhead above the highway, visible in the distance ahead of the ego vehicle.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the camera-host car from first-person dashcam view; the coach bus is the sole adversarial. 2. Chronology: Initially, the bus appears in the right lane behind/ beside the ego. At midpoint, the bus draws alongside with minimal clearance. In ending, the bus completes the overtake and merges ahead. 3. Evidence: The bus's lateral position shifts from right of ego to directly alongside, then ahead; its taillights become visible in front as it merges into the ego lane.
